lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You're awake. That's good. Better than I expected.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You were floating in the debris field. No ID. No memory, from what I can tell. You had a katana holstered to your belt, and a lot of augmentation. So I brought you in.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: How long?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Three weeks. You were unconscious for the better part of the first one. Your body's running on something I don't fully understand. But you're stable now. That's what matters.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: My name?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You don't have one. Not anymore. Not that you remember.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: But you will. First things first. Can you stand?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I can move.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: One thing before you find your feet. The Dominion sweeps this sector for salvage every few weeks, and one's overdue. I've kept you hidden three weeks, I can't hide you through an inspection.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: So when they board, and they will, be ready to move.

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper 1
lines.text: Medical bay contact. Breach imminent!

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper 2
lines.text: Target's armed! Weapons hot!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Routine check. This happens every few weeks. They like to remind us they're in charge.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I had the chance to hand you over for 3 weeks now. Didn't.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Because six years ago, you saved my life. I was Dominion then, same as you. A raid went bad, I was pinned, written off for dead. You came back for me when the order was to leave me.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I disappeared after that. Walked off the raid, off the grid, off everything I'd been. Been drifting the fringe as a salvager ever since.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I wasn't looking for you. I was stripping a dead hauler for parts and there you were, in the debris. The moment I saw your face, I knew it.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: What is your name.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Just Kessler now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We've got a problem. Those troopers, their helmet feeds were live. Everything they saw went up to a Dominion relay before I could cut the signal.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Meaning?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Meaning a server somewhere just watched you fight. And their systems don't forget a face. Especially not yours.

lines.speaker: Ship computer
lines.text: Incoming message.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Recognition flag. Priority black.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Kessler. Don't think you can escape the Dominion's grasp. We already know who you are.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: We will keep your daughter Iris safe, for now. You will see her again when you return our lost item.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's Khall, high Dominion. If his systems have your face, hiding's finished. For both of us.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: They have your daughter. I will not let her be harmed because of me. Turn me in!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Nonsense. They will not harm her. They are just using her as leverage. We need to take her back, and anyone in the way learns why they should've left you in the dark.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then we save her. Together.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Keep your hood up. This market's crawling with Dominion eyes.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Somebody here runs cargo for the garrison. Find them, and we find the way in.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'll watch the exits. Go on, ask around.

lines.speaker: Dock Hand
lines.text: You're not from the platforms. I can tell.

lines.speaker: Dock Hand
lines.text: The Dominion command? That's the old relay compound, past the cargo cranes. Don't go near it.

lines.speaker: Dock Hand
lines.text: Whatever they're holding in there, it isn't worth your life.

lines.speaker: Trader
lines.text: Information's not free, stranger. But I hate those Dominion boots, so listen.

lines.speaker: Trader
lines.text: The compound guards rotate at dusk. Three on the door. Quiet types.

lines.speaker: Trader
lines.text: Get inside, find their command terminal. Everything they move through this world is logged there.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm patched into your feed. Three hostiles in the entry hall, take them down fast.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Past them there's a corridor. The command room's at the end. That's where their data lives.

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper
lines.text: Contact! Engaging!

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper
lines.text: Thermal signature converging on platform! Containing spread!

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper
lines.text: Unit approaching! All available teams to the command room!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You're in. Pulling the manifest now...

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: No. No, no, no... They moved her. Iris isn't in the school anymore.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She's in Dominion custody. Transit-classified. Destination logged as, Velorum Station.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: An auction. They're going to sell her. We move now, get back to the ship.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Check the silver planet, Aquilane. Water-mining world. Nothing but storms and silver seas down there.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion runs a relay platform on the surface. That's the place where Iris's school was.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Set us down clean.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Velorum Station. It's a hub where assets and intelligence are brokered under cover of an open market.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We don't hide and we don't wait. We walk into Velorum, we find the right buyer, and we get the location.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Into the lion's mouth.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We find Iris. We don't stop until we do.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Watch out! Hostiles closing in!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Heads up! Enemy ships, right on top of us!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Contacts inbound! They're coming for us, watch yourself!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Skies are clear. Follow the marker, that's where we're headed next.
